concept: Kinesis Data Streams: real-time ingest, multiple consumers, replay
tests: Choosing a service for a continuous high-volume clickstream with multiple consumers of the same stream.
expected: Kinesis Data Streams: high real-time throughput, multiple consumers independently read the same records. Triggers: "high-volume continuous stream", "real time", "multiple consumers reading the same stream", clickstream.
why_not: SQS messages are typically consumed once; SNS is pub/sub; Glue is batch ETL, not real-time ingestion.
